title: A Outra
description: A man is cheating his woman with another lady, the 3 go on a trip to Mozambique, where the cheated one not knowing the affair, gets attacked by a lion, this woman, Beatriz, is taken by doctors, and disappears. At least it is what people thought

title: A Wedding, A Forgotten Debt
description: Three years ago, Martha Hale’s husband and son died saving everyone in their building during an earthquake. But neighbor Rita Kerr soon forgot their sacrifice and even saw Martha as “bad luck.” Now, as Rita’s son Dylan Crowe prepares for his wedding, Martha decides to make everyone face the truth: honoring the dead means honoring life, and gratitude should never be forgotten.

title: A Mulher-Serpente e a Flor
description: Renata (Ciça Manzano) leaves the groom at the altar and takes refuge in a beach house where she falls in love with Mirtsa, a mysterious neighbor. After discovering revealing family secrets, she is raped and threatened by a maniac, who engages her in a plot of revenge, sadism and death. Inspired by a short story by Cassandra Rios.

title: Like a Moth to a Flame
description: An anthology film featuring three stories of closeted men and how their sexual obsessions lead to violence.

title: A látogatás
description: The Hungarian writer Edith Bruck, who lives and works abroad, returns to her native village after many decades. The visit breaks the old wounds and makes those affected face the past.

title: A Wedding
description: Zahira, 18, is close to her family until her parents ask her to follow Pakistani tradition to choose a husband. Torn between family customs and her western lifestyle, the young woman turns for help to her brother and confidant Amir.

title: A Goat for a Vote
description: The best way to understand our society is to look at one's children. Three students in Kenya compete to become the next school president. Winning the election not only gives them the possibility for power and respect, but guarantees them a future in Kenyan society. Magdalene, has to prove herself in a boy dominated school which has never been led by a girl. She has the impossible task to unite all girls in her fight for equal rights. Harry, from a poor family, hopes to win so he can take care of his family in the future. He struggles against the popular Said who is a natural born leader with a disarming smile.

title: A Poem a Day
description: Hospital staff navigate their careers in physical therapy. Ye Jae Wook leads and teaches, Woo Bo Young chose the field despite wanting to be a poet, and Shin Min Ho studies unwillingly due to parental pressure.

title: A Cure or a Curse
description: Ben Jagger, a nationally renowned medical expert, is specially recruited by the hospital director with a generous salary to join the traditional medicine department. However, when the director's daughter, Quinn Lane, takes over, she immediately shuts down the department, dismissing traditional medicine as worthless and leaving no place for experts like Ben.

title: A/k/a Tommy Chong
description: Documentary about Tommy Chong's federal prosecution under the Bush administration for selling bongs over the Internet.

title: A Method to a Sweet Science

description: The journey of two girls to achieve their dream. Will their dream come true?

title: A csodacsatár
description: Mail author for translation. Futbólia minisztertanácsa ehatározza, hogy megszerzi az ország- nak a világhírû magyar csodacsatárt. Duca tengernagyra bízzák az akció végrehajtását. A magyar csapat éppen Svájcban ját- szik, Duca tehát odautazik embereivel. A labdarúgokat két nyugaton élõ magyar--Bruno és Jóska--követi a szállodába, hogy töltõtollakat adjon el nekik. Véletlenül õket is lefény- képezik, s Duca tengernagy Jóskát raboltatja el. A szeren--csétlennek döntõ mérkõzésen kell játszania, a dolog botrányba fullad, s a szurkolók már-már forradalmat robbantanak ki..

title: A Concerto Is a Conversation
description: A virtuoso jazz pianist and film composer tracks his family's lineage through his 91-year-old grandfather from Jim Crow Florida to the Walt Disney Concert Hall.

title: Norbert(a)
description: Norbert, a 65-year-old from a working-class area, plans a major heist to finance his gender transition surgery.

title: Lose a Girl Score a Boy
description: After believing campus idol Lucian Harrington stole his girlfriend, nerdy Micah Cooper publicly kisses him during a championship game as revenge. Instead of humiliation, the kiss awakens a secret Lucian has kept hidden for years—he's been hopelessly in love with Micah all this time.

title: A Viagem
description: Antonio decides to break free of his mundane existence and rents a silver convertible to take his wife on a dream vacation. Everything seems perfect. Except he doesn't know the way.

title: A Extorsão
description: Caught in a compromising situation, couple is blackmailed but, since they don't accept to play the game, their daughter is kidnapped and may be killed.

title: A New Mom, A New Beginning
description: After giving birth, Claire Miller plans to stay home briefly before moving into a postpartum care center. But her in-laws, Vivian Dawson and Bruce Carter, and brother-in-law Ryan Carter move in, claiming to help while doing nothing. Claire is treated like a servant, even losing the nourishing soup she made to Ryan. Her husband, Evan Carter, lets his family take her savings for his brother’s new car. Finally, Claire sees their true colors and fights back.

title: A Identidade
description: Um misterioso assassinato ocorreu na Colégio da Barra, a melhor escola de elite de São Paulo. Isto causou um enorme conflito entre três estudantes pobres que ingressaram na escola com bolsas de estudo e os filhos de famílias ricas com origens proeminentes. Além das enormes diferenças de classe, o ensino interno do colégio é cheio de conspiração e complexidade. Quem é o verdadeiro assassino deste caso?

title: A Sketch of a Rainy Day
description: The story of Ji-su who life was torn by two women in his life. One of them is his step-sister and the other is a barroom dancer named Kyung-ja.

title: A Tale of a Naughty Girl
description: Based on a short story by Bengali writer Prafulla Roy, the central idea developed by director Dasgupta, tells the story of a girl, Lati, whose mother Rajani is a prostitute living and working in a brothel in rural India. Rajani plans to offer her daughter to an older man, a rich husband and protector to her daughter. Lati, however, wants to return to school and finish her studies. Unwilling to pay such a price for material success, she runs away to Calcutta. The discovery of this new world is described parallel to other stories of emancipation, such as that of three young prostitutes, of an aged couple going nowhere and man's n landing on the moon. In a surrealistic approach typical of the director, a clumsy cat and an intelligent donkey are also present in the film.

description: Zen Luo, who is now a menial slave, used to be a young master of a big family, owing to the decline of his family, his sister is imprisoned by a strong force, he has no choice but to be at others' service. However, Every cloud has a silver lining, The ancient book left by his father actually conceals the magical spell, which can change a human into an instrument. What's the mysterious power behind all these? This is contest with fate.

title: Awaken the Infinite Money System
description: In a world where money buys magic, broke Kai Seldon is crushed by billionaire heir Andre Sterling, who owns the Guild and his mother's debt. With Raven’s scheme, Kai turns ledgers into weapons, forces a rematch, and watches a whole Arena pay for a miracle as Sterling's empire collapses. Left with real power, he learns what money can’t buy: the choice to become more is yours alone.

title: Ça, c'est Paris!
description: François, owner of Tout-Paris cabaret, struggles to decide between selling his historic venue or keeping the legacy. Amid personal stories of dancers Justine, Teresa, and Coralie, the cabaret troupe rallies to recapture its former glory.

title: The Mysterious Miss C.
description: Mademoiselle C is a strange but touching woman. She, among others excentricities, talks to a small rock, Gertrude, like if she was alive. She is the supply teacher of the 6D, the worst group of St-Cécile Elementary School. When she arrives, Mademoiselle C, with her never ending imagination, will accomplish a true revolution in the elementary school and especially in the group 6D. This movie praise the right to be different and unique. It is also a movie about the happiness of reading and the power of imagination.

title: Capital C
description: CAPITAL C is the first documentary about crowdfunding. It follows the hopes and dreams as well as the fears and pitfalls of a whole new generation of independent creators, who reach out to the crowd in order to change their lives forever.

title: The Romance of Tiger and Rose
description: A young screenwriter falls ill while working on a script and wakes up as one of her characters.

description:
Reborn two hours before the zombie apocalypse, Alex Carter remembers everything—and refuses to fail again.
Gathering allies, stockpiling weapons, and building a base, he becomes the ultimate protector.

description: According to legends, the god of war saved the heavens in a deadly battle against the demon a thousand years ago. Both fell from the heavens and disappeared from the world.

title: c/o Segemyhr
description: Four people living together in an apartment can give rise to a lot of funny situations, especially if they are as different as these four: Fredrik is the nominal apartment owner, a bit superior to the others, currently "between two jobs". His girlfriend Cilla would prefer that they lived there alone, without Fredrik's crude brother Jan-Olof or the young cab driver Anton.

title: When I Fly Towards You
description: Set off by a sweet chance encounter, 16-year-old Su Zaizai finds herself helplessly drawn to Zhang Lurang - her smart, charming yet distant schoolmate.

title: Sir C. P.
description: Sir CP is a story about a fraud college owner who specializes in providing any degree, which is available in any university across the world, to his students. His work lands him in deep trouble and how he comes out of it forms the plot.

title: Now Is the Time
description: In 1969, fifty years before this film is released, an indigenous community in Canada succeeds in constructing and erecting a totem pole, a practice which had been suppressed for decades by the local authorities.

title: The C-Bazz Cast
description: The C-Bazz Cast show "Where we have a whole lot of fun just for you" The first episode kicks off with the crazy four (C-Bazz, K-Shan, Howard Hall and DJ GYMC) bringing the funny. Special in studio guest Brandon Abidin and Jennifer Abidin of Intelligent Mortgage.

title: Ne Zha 2
description: After a great catastrophe, the souls of Nezha and Aobing are saved, but their bodies face ruin. To give them new life, Taiyi Zhenren turns to the mystical seven-colored lotus in a daring bid to rebuild them and change their fate.

title: The Dragon King's Hot Valet is a runaway mommy
description: Five years ago, herbalist Cecilia slept with fire-poisoned Dragon King Evander and bore a half-dragon cub, Milo. To afford Milo's suppressant, she disguises herself as a man and becomes the king's manservant. Guarding her secret, she turns rival heiress Willow into a best friend. The king falls for his "male servant" and spirals into jealous self-doubt.

title: From His Surrogate to the Royal Princess
description: Adopted by the Leora family, Omega Eve is betrayed by her sister and her mate. To them, she's nothing more than a surrogate. Then she breaks the mate bond, exposes their scheme, and turns out to be the long-lost princess of the Northern Wolf Pack. When her ex comes crawling back, she shuts him down and chooses the ever-loyal Leonard.

description: Told about a pair of twin sisters with disparate personalities in the royal family of human clans, because a mistake brings about the wrong marriage, not only making countless jokes, but bringing out more of two romantic love.

title: Ruling Over All I See (DUBBED)
description: Soon after unemployed graduate Judah Shaw finds himself a penniless scholar in Qirelia, he is forced by the system to win his wives' affection, despite their marriages being purely convenient. To his surprise, among them are a princess, a general's daughter, and a merchant heiress, who bring him not only fortune but also a future brighter than he ever imagined.

title: (Doublage) LA BELLE ET LE GARDE
description: (Doublage) LA BELLE ET LE GARDE

title: Ruling Over All I See II: Path to Dominion(DUBBED)
description: Judah Shaw transmigrates into the ancient world, married to three wealthy wives. But before he gets to enjoy life, his second wife Willa Zorath gets abducted by Lotia Sect, who aims to have Judah surrender to them. Unwilling to yield, he defeats the sect leader and saves Willa, only to then be hunted by Ian Walton. But now bound with the sect leader's power, he easily reclaims safety—and starts a rebellion for justice.

title: My Unicorn Girl
description: When she was eighteen, Sang Tian makes a wish to enter her mother's school to become part of the Chinese figure skating team. However, she did not pass the ranking test but somehow disguises as a guy and was accepted into the Ice Hockey team. Having no choice, she adopted a new identity. However, her plan was foiled by the sudden appearance of Wen Bing. Wen Bing and Sang Tian become room-mates. After one encounter, the two former "arch enemies" suddenly become good friends. The two of them decide to work together with their team mates and do their best in the championships. However, Sang Tian's secret was eventually exposed. Despite this, she still gets the chance to become a member of the first all-female Ice Hockey team. Sang Tian is finally able to become a real girl and continue chasing her dream.

description: After an accident leaves Shen Mo with amnesia, he mistakes Ji Mingxuan, the man who saved him, for his lover. But when Shen Mo regains his memories, the six months they spent loving each other become completely erased. Desperate to keep Shen Mo by his side, Ji Mingxuan proposes a three-year ""contract lover"" arrangement. When two people are already in love, can a contract still keep their hearts in check?

title: Temps Perdu, Regrets Laissés ( Doublé )
description: Léa Durand est en couple avec Gaston Martin, issu d'une famille riche. Lorsque Gaston a une maladie incurable, Léa est enceinte, et apprend la véritable identité de Gaston. Pour le sauver, elle le quitte délibérément. Elle donne naissance à leur fils Arthur. Cinq ans plus tard, Arthur a un accident de voiture. Léa fait appel à Gaston. La fiancée de Gaston complote pour faire mourir l'enfant, et rejette la faute sur Gaston. Le malentendu entre Gaston et Léa s'aggrave.

title: The Prosecutor
description: A poor young man is wrongly charged with drug trafficking after being deceived. An ex-prosecutor investigates the case, uncovers a corrupt lawyer team's scheme, and restores justice despite obstruction from evil forces.

headers.User-Agent: com.community.oneroom/50020119 (Linux; U; Android 11; en_US; M2012K11AG; Build/RP1A.200720.011; Cronet/135.0.7012.3)

title: Fallen Princess, Rising Empress
description: After her kingdom falls, Princess Claire Rowan survives only to be handed to Regent Victor Bishop as a tool of humiliation. Burning with vengeance for her slain family, Claire uses her wit to navigate the royal court, quietly building her power to save her people. Victor's disdain slowly turns to love as he realizes she's the very woman who once saved his life.

title: Tininti del barrio
description: The most delightful rip-roaring, comedy of the year.

title: (Doublage) CHASSÉ, JE DEVIENS MARCHAND DES DEUX MONDES
description: (Doublage) CHASSÉ, JE DEVIENS MARCHAND DES DEUX MONDES

title: [Doublé]Sous le Sceau du Pouvoir
description: Estelle Marin et Édouard Valois, confrontés à des conflits de pouvoir et d'émotion, se retrouvent dans un jeu politique complexe. Face à la tyrannie de l'empereur, Estelle s'allie avec le Prince Louis Valois pour renverser le régime et sauver le royaume, tout en naviguant à travers des luttes émotionnelles intenses.

title: Meridiano Zero
description: A story of drugs and lives.

title: Escalators
description: Entirely set on escalators, the film gives insight into the lives and stories of average people spending a fraction of each day on moving stairs.

title: The Story of Ming Lan
description: An unfavoured child of a rich family, Ming Lan studies and works hard, and falls in love with the son of a high official. Through cunning schemes, they both rise in position and work to obtain justice from those that have wronged them.

title: Crowned by His Love	(DUBBED)
description: To escape the marriage her mother tried to force on her, Tina Carter has a one-night stand with Ethan Brooks and ends up unexpectedly pregnant. Five years later, Ethan discovers the truth: he has a son. As he fights to win back both Tina and his son, jealousy and sabotage from Zoe Turner threaten to tear them apart. Ethan risks everything to protect them. Just then, she finds she is the true heiress of the Turner family—switched at birth by the very woman she called mother.

title: X-Ray Eyes, Billionaire Rise
description: When poor student Lincoln Cross is hit by campus queen Audrey Sterling, he suddenly gains powerful X-ray vision. His astonishing talent leaves gang heiress Vera Blackwood, stunning sisters Blair Leighton & Amber Collins, and the elegant Audrey Sterling utterly captivated. After all—who wouldn’t want a walking god of wealth? Adapted from a hit web novel.

title: Love at Dangerous Speeds
description: A runaway bride finds refuge with a charismatic street racer. As their deal turns to love, a devastating connection from their past threatens to shatter their newfound happiness and force her to make an impossible choice.

title: Online Boyfriend is My Boss
description: After a year of online dating with her boyfriend who works abroad, Su Xiaoxiao, who is full of expectations, unexpectedly learn that her new big boss Xu Yanshen turn out to be her online boyfriend. Xu Yanshen keeps asking Su Xiaoxiao to meet offline by message, but Su Xiaoxiao decide to hide the truth out of inferiority.

title: The Immortal's Return(English-dubbed)
description: Invincible Grandmaster Arthur descends into the mortal world. He sparks a fiery romance with his childhood sweetheart while captivating a martial arts goddess and a wealthy heiress. Thrust into Meridian's brutal war for supremacy, Arthur ruthlessly crushes every rival, sweeping aside all obstacles to claim his throne at the absolute peak.

title: Vingt ans d'Amour, Trois ans d'Oubli ( Doublé )
description: Le jour de leur 20e anniversaire de mariage, la femme d'Aaron part à l'étranger avec leur fils pour célébrer l'anniv de son ancien amour. Ils sont kidnappés, Aaron se précipite avec la rançon, mais faute de fonds suffisants, sa famille l'oblige à se substituer en otage. Après trois ans d'attente, Aaron ne découvre qu'un foyer boulversé à son retour : un fils indigne et une femme distante. À bout, Aaron quitte le foyer, laissant sa femme et son fils rongés de remords.

title: L.O.R.D. Critical World
description: As the 7th duke, Yin Chen (Joe Cheng Yuan Chang) has the ability to wield the power of the wind, fire, water, and earth. As he tries to protect his disciple Qi Ling (Ming'en Zhang), he uncovers an earth-shattering secret.

title: The Legend in the Shadows
description: Ethan Sloan, a legendary ex-soldier and dark lord, is sent to protect cold, silent CEO Celine Blaker. Due to a misunderstanding, she mistakes him for a thug. But as Ethan resolves crisis after crisis, he effortlessly crushes all rival forces and slaps villains in the face. His unmatched strength and charm finally win her over, as he forges a passionate urban legend.

description: Eddie and Manecas are two friends who like to think they lead a double life as special forces agents, without the knowledge of their wives. One day they receive a message to go to Viana do Castelo and eliminate a dangerous target.

title: Belas e Corrompidas
description: Mentally disturbed woman always ends up killing her lovers.

title: Acqua e anice
description: A "dance hall road movie" about Olimpia, a legendary ballroom dancer and a fixture at local dance halls, who, at age seventy, dusts off her orchestra's tour bus.

title: Sheher E Ajnabi
description: This is a story of a girl Ufaq who is trapped in the nest of real and fake relations.Just to fulfill her one wish Ufaq ends up ignoring all her loved ones and eventually loses interest in her own self. Her aunt takes advantage of her weakness. In the course of events Ufaq never gives up and life bestows her with her share of happiness.

title: Vremeto e nashe
description: During a turmoil period in Bulgaria, after the communist regime fell, the writer Martin Sestrimski receives a dangerous file about himself from his friend Boyan Tilev - a DS (National Security Service) agent.

title: Asta e
description: The portrait of three generations of inhabitants of the Danube Delta.

title: Demônios e Maravilhas
description: A self indulgent, autobiographical docu-drama that chronicles the filmmaker's "struggle" with narrow minded authorities, critics, and personal tragedy.

title: Dokhtar-e shaah-e parian
description: A young thief who wants to steal from a rich girl is fall in love with her. He not let his friend to steal the girl too. After many adventures finally the girl prefers him to her other suitor and they get marry.

title: E-Preeti
description: When a computer professional relocates to the USA with ambitions of becoming a successful entrepreneur, he learns about the life of an Indian immigrant abroad and soon falls in love with his boss. How will his future unfold?

title: Rasm-e Asheghi
description: Rasm-e Asheghi

title: Tabl-e bozorg zir-e pai-e chap
description: After a fierce battle in the war the soldiers of both sides are tired and thirsty. A stream of water is between them and they all must try to get it and drink.

title: Umberto E
description: The story of 90-year old Umberto Evangelista's own vivid recollections of his life as an eternal immigrant, both in Italy and in the United States. A story of personal triumph, choosing love and forgiveness as his weapons of "revenge."

title: Le mille e una notte... e un'altra ancora!
description: A sultan regularly decapitates his lovers after enjoying them for one night. Two girls avoid death by telling the man some exciting stories.

title: Cosimo e Nicole
description: 2011. Genoa. G8. Cosimo, an Italian boy, helps Nicole, French. A look: it is love. Then the two boys return to Genoa; here they work for a friend, Paul, concert organizer. This goes on until Alioune, a young illegal immigrant, falls from a scaffold, working for a stage with Cosimo. The boy remains there, abandoned by Paul, Cosmas and Nicole.

title: Burn-E
description: If BURN-E (a welding robot) had known how much trouble he'd be caused by WALL-E's pursuit of EVE, then he'd have taken the day off.

description: A look at life in Eastern Europe after the collapse of the Soviet Union.

title: Callas e Onassis
description: The life and passionate love of famous opera singer Maria Callas and Greek billionaire Aristotle Onassis.

title: Zir-e Derakht-e Holou
description: In Arefpour's family there is a tradition and that is: everybody before dying sees in a dream that he will die. The head of the family sees in a dream that he will die soon so he tells his servant Safa to calls his son Masoud. The will is in a safe and the key is with Safa the servant but according to the father before reading the will the son Masoud must find a wife for the servant to get marry with. Many widows come to the house to marry Safa the servant but he is not agreeing at all making reading the will impossible.

title: Belarmino e Gabriela
description: The Brazilian comedians and singers Belarmino and Gabriela (Salvador Graciano and Júlia Alves) made a big hit in southern Brazil between the 1940s and 1970s. The documentary shows the life of the two artists from Paraná with testimonials from relatives and friends.

title: Atash-e penhan
description: It invokes the memory of the 16 September 1982 massacre at the Sabra and Shatila refugee camp in West Beirut. In the early 1980s at a poolside gathering in southern Lebanon Jacob, a Jew of Lebanese extraction, is killed along with a number of his associates by a group of Israelis dressed as Palestinian combatants. Jacob's sister and his daughter Sara survive the attack. The Palestinian combatants realize the goal of the Israelis is to incite public opinion against their struggle so they expose the ones who are really behind the attack. After taking part in an unsuccessful terrorist operation against Abu Khalil and his son Abu Ali, Sara realizes her Israeli fiance designed and executed the plot to kill her father. Israeli soldiers retaliate and arrest a group of Palestinian leaders, including Abu Khalil. After this incident two Palestinian combatants wipe out the Israeli Command Staff in a suicide operation.

title: Meeadgah-e khashm
description: After loosing his wife Ghadam (Mohammadali Fardin) start searching for the killer.

title: Eynak-e doodi
description: A rich couple Sina and Mina want to get divorce and go to the marriage office. But when Mina notices a young girl who her father is forcing her to get marry she decides to help her which is only the beginning of the troubles.

title: Anema e core
description: Two two-bit singers become thieves to make ends meet. One day during a theft in the house of a music impresario they hear Marco an electrician gifted with a beautiful voice and give him some money to help for his debut as a singer. The youth however gives the money to a dishonest girl he's in love with who gives it to her delinquent boy-friend. But when everybody seems to be in trouble because of his behaviour Marco repents and begins his career.

title: Angoshtar-e Sehramiz
description: The story of a selfish prince, his degeneration reaches to such an extend that he completely forgets love, kindness and friendship. He inherited the ring from his father. Whenever he made a mistake, the magic ring stings his finger.

title: Elaan-E-Jung
description: A small Indian village is terrorized by terrorist Kalanag, who wants to destroy the country and become its ruler.

title: Io e Angela
description: Arturo, a placid forty-year-old, unexpectedly receives the visit of an Angel of Death: a sexy woman with a weakness for tequila and younger boys. The supernatural being, Angela, invites him to a quick departure. However, Arturo wants to make a pact with his incorrect escort: he will accept his Destiny only if she helps him take revenge on all those who have made fun of him. The bet is tough: if Arturo disappears from the Register of the Morituri, Angela will lose her immortality. Who between the two will be able to defeat Death a second time?

title: Iyawo E
description: Despite the hardship Sade faced while growing up, she excelled through the hurdles when a benefactor renders a helping hand but unknowingly he had an ulterior motive. Find out more.

title: Fratelli e sorelle
description: After twenty years of marriage, Gloria discovers that her husband has been cheating on her. It' a terrible trauma and she decides to stay with her sister in USA in St. Louis. She takes with her Matteo and Francesco, her two sons. Matteo wastes no time in settling into his new life, but Francesco find it more difficult, being shy and full of complexes.

title: Rustom-E-Rome
description: When the kingdom of Jamah is attacked, the emperor is killed, his wife, Anam flees with her two infant sons, but ends up getting separated from them. She tries to kill herself, but Daresh Baba counsels her, brings her home and lets her live there so that she can look after his mother-less daughter, Shabana. Years later, Shabana has grown up and is in love with a young wrestler, Arsalan, who is Anam's son. Her other son, Firdaus, is still alive, and has been bestowed the title of 'Rustom-E-Rome' by none other than Shehzadi Ruma, who plans to marry him. Before that could happen, Firdaus is given a priceless knife and is asked to locate it's twin, and Shabana gets abducted by bandits. In the process of locating Shabana, Firdaus not only loses the knife, but also puts his, Shabana's and Arsalan's lives in jeopardy.

title: Umm-e-Ayesha
description: A devout young woman navigates modern society while staying true to her religious beliefs, facing challenges as she balances her faith with contemporary pressures.

title: Super F***ers
description: A team of super-powered teens use their powers to get high, play pranks, and fight everyone except the bad guys.

title: Hurricane F.Y.T.
description: -Montreal (in Canada), 1991. Eleven year old Delphis grew up in a poor neighborhood and an unstable family environment. One night he decides to take control of his life and becomes L'Ouragan (Hurricane). Armed with a lightning bolt on his bandanna and his middle finger held high, he leads his life as he sees fit, in a world that has no place for him. His adventure is like a road trip, from the slums to downtown, from one family to another. In the course of his time on the streets and in his attempts to conquer himself, he finds what's most important: his purity.

title: F(l)ag Football
description: Three teams and their journey to become the next Gay Bowl Champions. With everything on the line, some teams will come together and others will fall apart, but gay sports will never be seen the same way again.

title: F-Listers
description: F-Listers are aspiring actors, the opposite of A-List Actors. Often referred to as laughing-stocks for their dedication to their failed acting careers, in which they forget their age and to pay rent, they are called F-Listers, F for Failure. However, the F-Listers, see it differently; the capital F is for Faith, and perhaps, Faith for future Fame. Mark Star - the self-proclaimed Rock Star; Lizolet - an optimistic Ukrainian Writer who can't spell well; Jimi Choopchick - a lisping wannabe Social Influencer; Cousin Sit - a cross-dressing Model and a bad cab driver, and Mama Star, a cheery BG actress from the heyday Hollywood. They gather with other multi-national actors to make their own movie where every extra has a speaking role.

title: F... U, OK?
description: Join the comic misadventures of 4 just-out-of-college friends with a kooky business idea. As they embark on an all-night contraceptive delivery service, fresh nuances of modern love and relationships begin to unfold in front of their eyes.

title: Rio, 100 Degrees F.
description: A semi-documentary on the people of Rio de Janeiro. The camera follows boys from a hillside shanty town who sell peanuts at Copacabana, Sugar Loaf Mountain, and a soccer game. Various subplots, involving characters they meet along the way, are interspersed.

title: CHEF F, GOÛT S
description: CHEF F, GOÛT S

title: F-Zero: Farukon densetsu
description: The year is 2201 and across the universe rabid fans flock to F-Zero tracks everywhere. The prizes are enormous and the stakes grow even higher when the outlaws compete to win - at any cost. But the Elite Mobile Task Force, a team of high-risk racers, stands at the ready. Driven by a need for speed and a thirst for victory, the Task Force is determined to keep the prize money out of evil hands by defeating the menacing Black Shadow and bringing peace to the entire galaxy.

title: You're F@#K'n Dead!
description: Two sisters take a wrong turn and find themselves in a strange, forgotten town not found on any map. When the sisters discover the town's true dark nature, they become targets, fighting for their souls against an evil that will never let them leave.

title: F/X
description: A movie special effects man is hired to fake a real-life mob killing for a witness protection plan, but finds his own life in danger.

title: Entity F
description: We start at Wilfried's home. He is a paragnost who tells us his tale how he became involved with the paranormal. He also tells us that he is willing to help Amber and that this documentary will be his story. Amber has summoned a evil spirit in a abandoned building which has been haunting her ever since. There is only one opportunity to get rid of this evil spirit and that is go back where it all started.

title: F**k New York
description: On his last day in the big city, a disillusioned actor tries to make peace with never making it big.

title: G
description: Three friends, Robban, Alexander and Kim has just left the compulsory school, and now they consider themselves grown-up and mature, being 16 years old. During the summer holiday they also get a bit of experience of the world: Robban becomes a full-time drug addict, Alexander plays in a rock band but leaves it and Kim is desperate to get the girl of his dreams.

title: Oh My G!
description: Sophie Cepeda is a teenager who struggles after both her parents died. Sophie blamed God for the loss of her loved ones, until God himself appears to Sophie in different forms to enlighten the latter on the obstacles she is facing.

title: I Do, I Don't
description: With a weakening marriage, Shawn and Jess turn to a faith-based retreat to salvage their union. As they seek reconciliation, an unexpected encounter causes Shawn to question his faith, marriage, and belief in God.

title: I Will
description: I WILL celebrates the career and life of Grammy Award® winner and Academy Award® nominated actor Will Smith.

title: I Do, I Do
description: Hwang Ji An is the top shoe designer in a major shoe company. She is in her 30s, successful and single. One night, she makes a horrible mistake and sleeps with Park Tae Gang, a good-looking new employee in her company, and she finds out she is pregnant. Ji An's hard-earned career and her stylish lifestyle threatens to implode as a result of her one-night-stand mistake. Will Ji An be forced to give up everything and live with the consequences of her mistake?

title: Juan Gabriel: I Must, I Can, I Will
description: A tribute showcasing rare archives and personal narratives about the iconic Mexican singer.

title: Sa-rang-i i-gin-da
description: No pain, no gain. This is the motto of the Yoo family: the father is a successful doctor, the mother supervises their daughter's scholastic performance from the vantage point of their beautiful home. Then cracks appear in the facade which soon deepen and spread. In particular, the father seems to be losing control - he is suddenly faced with a sexual harassment lawsuit and an absurd running battle with a taxi driver.

Japoness marionettes Lime, Cherry, and Bloodberry are different from most others, because each possesses a special circuit that gives them human emotions. One by one, they are accidentally awakened by young Mamiya Otaru and take up residence with him. As a result, Otaru's uneventful life becomes just a tad more interesting. At the same time, conflict between Japoness and the city-state of Gartland is escalating. Is it because Faust, the leader of Gartland, lusts for world domination, or is it something else his heart longs for... something with a connection to Lime, Cherry, and Bloodberry?

title: Anna K.
description: Joana suffers from a double personality and is obsessed with Anna Karenina, the character from Tolstoy's novel. Embodying the myth of Narcissus, Anna K. is the image and resemblance of Joana, stronger and more seductive.

title: K Beauty Salon
description: Last April, BTS, the Korean boy band, was chosen by the Times magazine as one of the world's 100 most influential people in 2019. The Korean wave, now a worldwide phenomenon, also includes K-beauty, the Korean way of beauty, fashion and style increasingly influencing the global trend. 'Beauty' Is beyond just looking good, it's more about being self-confident and loved. 'Beauty' is one of the common interests of people around the world. TBC's K-beauty salon is a 'global beauty' program that shares and empathizes 'K-beauty' with the global citizens. More specifically, it offered top-notch beauty service to the Vietnamese local residents of Danang for 3 days, by opening a special salon with Korean beauty artists and celebrities. We present an unforgettable memory to the local customers by interacting with them, under the slogan of 'beauty'

title: Tie Me (K)not
description: After enduring continuous physical and psychological abuse from her cheating husband and controlling mother-in-law, Lalita is too heartbroken to endure her marriage. When she seeks a divorce, her father disowns her. Lalita's life has been controlled by a man since birth, but no more. After the divorce, Lalita begins a journey of self-growth and advancement to prove that no girl needs a man to determine her worth. Alas, the road is filled with setbacks and obstacles. But Lalita is determined; she begins working as a model.

title: K.O. Beast
description: Set in the distant future in which the Earth is split in two. The southern hemisphere is placed in another dimension while the inhabitants of the northern hemisphere are able to morph into beast-like humanoids. Eventually the humans of the southern hemisphere, led by Uranus, attack the Beasts. The Three Beasts, Wan Derbard (Wan Dabadadatta) of the Tiger Tribe, Bud Mint (Baado Mint) of the Bird Tribe, and Mei Mer (Mei Mah) of the Mermaid Tribe, are taken prisoner along with Mei Mer's companion Tuttle Millen (Mekka Mannen, also of the Mermaid tribe), but manage to escape thanks to a little girl named Yuuni Charm Password. Together they seek Gaia, which they believe to be a fabulous treasure, but they are pursued by Uranus's minions : V-Darn the vicious mage-knight, V-Sion the warrior woman and Akumako, V-Darn's sadistic imp-like partner.

title: Kadhal Pagadai
description: Kadhal Pagadai revolves around middle-class families in Konar Colony, in Chennai, in the late 1990s. The show showcases the struggles revolving in middle-class families and the youngsters love live, through emotional outbursts, with comic reliefs here and there. Though there is no main characters, the story mainly revolves around a family living in Konar Colony. The family is led by Mohanbabu, a clerk in a government office, though his wife Vanja is the one leading the family as the only woman. Mohanbabu younger brother, Rajbabu, is a clerk in a chit fund company. He has a girlfriend named Sithara, who is an orphan. Rajbabu hides this fact from his family, as he want to settle first before marrying Sithara. But Sithara's flashback from her college days involving Ramana, forces Rajbabu to introduce her to his family, and his elder sister, Girija gets an instant dislike for Sithara. Girija comes down to Chennai from Saudi, seeking money from her brothers, to release her husband from jail back in Saudi. At the same time, Rajbabu losses the chitfund money, due to a sinister plan laid by his office peon, Sanjeevi. Ramana comes forward to offer money to help Rajbabu and Sithara but has a condition that Sithara should stay with him in his Cunnor Estate for 10 days. If Sithara stills loves Rajbabu after their mutual stay, Ramana would not trouble them anymore. Having faith in Sithara and desperately in need for money, Rajbabu convinces a reluctant Sithara to go with Ramana. But soon, his faith turns into a possessive behavior and Rajbabu refuses to trust Sithara. Though, this is the main gist of the plot, Kadhal Pagadai also revolves around other families in the Colony. One such family is the ultra rich and arrogant woman who bought the house that she stayed in. A strict old man with 2 daughters, who is the only man in the colony to have a telephone, which irritates him as he has to pass messages to the people in the colony. His elder daughter, Nandhini who loves her neighbour, a mechanic and the duo runs away when her father opposes. A Palakad Brahmin family, who is one of the main comic relief in the show. A disabled helper around the colony, named Ayyappan. A struggling cinema actor, also a fraud, with whom Sithara's friend Sundari was in love with, but breaks up after knowing his fraudulent nature. How all these families overcome their daily challenges? Would Ramana win Sithara's heart? Or would Rajbabu and Sithara unite again? forms the climax.

title: Vasantham Vanthachu
description: Kumaresan (Venkat Prabhu) is a milk vendor in his village, who hates the marriage and stays away from women. His elderly father (Velu Thigal) wants him to get married as soon as possible, but the Kumaresan stubbornly refuses to get married. During the college holidays, the city girl Gayathri (Nanditha Jennifer) comes to stay with her grandparents Chettiar (Shanmugasundaram) and Meenakshi (Varalakshmi). After initial clashes between Kumaresan and Gayathri, Gayathri is intrigued by its refusal to get married. In the past, Kumaresan's brother got secretly married to a woman from a rich family. Kumaresan's family welcomed him and were happy for them. The young Kumaresan clashed with his sister-in-law, therefore the young couple left their home. Kumaresan fell sick after the departure of the couple, then Kumaresan and his father begged Kumaresan's brother to call on their mother (Sabitha Anand) but his sister-in-law refused to let him go. Before she died, Kumaresan's mother Chellamma asked Kumaresan to not be like his brother and to stay with his father. That day, Kumaresan took the decision of remaining single. Meanwhile, Gayathri falls in love with Kumaresan. Gayathri then tied the mangala sutra to herself and lied to the villagers that Kumaresan is the one who tied the knot. Gayathri's grandparents and Kumaresan's father agree for their marriage. Kumaresan doesn't want to live with her, so he tries several ways to drive Gayathri out of his house. Afterwards, the village doctor Rajasekhar (Ramji), who knows about the matter, establishes the truth at the village court and the couple split up. Gayathri then goes to back to her parents. Kumaresan, who felt alone, realises that he was in love with Gayathri but it was too late. The film ends with Gayathri returning to his home and they immediately get married.

title: My Dearest Nemesis

title: Sju Kammers - Frontsøstrene
description: In Purcells opera Dido and Aenaes, Dido ends her own life with the words "Remember me, but forget my faith." Solace embodies this lament with women silenced by war, united in a choice they made when they were young. Through separate chapters we meet six women who once worked as Red Cross nurses at the Eastern Front. During WWII thousands of European women volunteered to the war zones to serve as nurses for the German Red Cross. In the front lines they cared for wounded German soldiers - and soldiers of other nationalities. These women became known as the Front sisters. On the journey back home after the war had ended they survived through a war-harried Germany. Many returned traumatised and would be socially harassed by their community. In Norway they were imprisoned for treason, condemned for saving the wrong lives. Solace is a film about young women who went out with a desire to help, for later to be associated with some of the most gruesome acts of the twentieth century. At the end of the road they finally dare to reveal some of their innermost painful memories, letting us in to their long-time secrete rooms for the first time.

title: M
description: M is a work of art that explores the relationship between sexuality and death. These two appear to be opposite forces, but in fact they merge in all of us, disguising the fear of death or the desire to die, the world of Eros and Thanatos. In M the character of Marilyn Monroe should be seen as a symbol of this interpenetration. The actress's death is as famous as her sexuality and thus sets a perfect example of how the ancient bond between sex and death is being forever mystified and exploited by the popular culture. M attempts to explore this phenomenon in a much more personal level. All the events in the work are fictional and they are set in no particular place or time. The work consists of film material that has been produced on and off in a time period of four years, beginning in March 2013 to December 2017. The footage was shot mainly in the home and grounds of Casa das Musas Art House in Nazare, Portugal. Other shooting locations were Litibu village in Mexico and Uusikaupunki, Finland. All the actors in the work are non-professionals and were chosen because of their strong essence and character. Although the work is based on a script the roles and events were adjusted to fit the actors presence, and all of the dialogue was acted by the artist herself as voiceover. At times the process of filming was on the verge of improvisation and therefore only the afterwork would fully determine how some of the scenes developed. This way of working turned out to be a crucial element of the work. M is not an attempt to tell a story or redefine a character. In fact it is quite the opposite. The elements of film are being used as pathways for the artist to move in and out of the characters, each character representing somewhat a side of the artists own fantasy. By placing herself in the part of an object of fantasy the artist strives to understand the unity of sex and death, not merely as a myth in popular culture, but as an integral part of humanity.

"Mama/M.A.M.A." is the provocative investigation of Munchausen Syndrome by Proxy, a perplexing psychological disorder where a mother secretly but deliberately harms her child in order to get the sympathy and praise of others and the attention of the medical community. What emerges over three years of scrutiny are disturbing questions related to the medical profession's arrogant use of the diagnosis, the possible contribution from the pharmaceutical industry, and its grievous impact on families. Questions addressed in this film include: Is this syndrome an authentic phenomenon or is it a witch hunt? What are the moral implications of a society that fails to question the science behind the disorder, blindly lending faith to its sensational existence? The deeply disturbing "Mama/M.A.M.A." closely follows three cases, allowing the audience to absorb all points of view and determine who the real abusers are. (Florida Film Festival)

title: Otis N' Dwayne
description: Two androgynous creatures embark on a psychotronic journey of self-discovery in a cruel, unusual, mostly male world in this dark comedy about two gay androids abandoned in a New Jersey suburb inhabited by God, the devil, and other lowlifes.

title: Kit N Sam
description: Sam and Kit have been a faithful couple going-steady for two years. They get engaged. About a week before their marriage, Kit comes up with a proposition, which she thinks will keep their marriage a success forever. She tells Sam that till marriage they should go out and taste the forbidden fruit of infidelity, so that they don't have any desire for other men/women after marriage - after much hesitation, Sam agrees to her proposal A hilarious turn of events ensue through the misadventures of Kit and Sam as they go about trying to have affairs with other men and women - until they realize what true love is.

title: Salt n' Pepper
description: The story of a few foodies, whose fondness of food bonds them together.

title: Rob N Roll
description: Decadent Murong Hui teams up with violent bandits after a botched robbery. A female detective pursues them as they scheme to steal a bag of money, leading to chaotic events due to betrayals and twists under the "I rob, you rob me" code.

title: King 'n' Me
description: An eccentric millionaire sends a documentary film crew on a search to find the most legendary icon in the history of rock n roll...The King. Is he alive, as many believe? If so, does he want to be found? Is there any credibility to the often ridiculous tales of sightings? What they soon find will not only change their careers, but also their lives.

title: Nikki & Nora: The N&N Files
description: The N&N Files follows New Orleans locals Nikki Beaumont (Liz Vassey) and Nora Delany (Christina Cox) as they juggle the inner-workings of their personal lives with their roles as private investigators in America's oldest party town.

title: Kit ^n^ Kate
description: Two small kitties named Kit and Kate love their toy box. As soon as they hop inside, magic starts to happen. Kids' imagination transforms their room into a blueberry island, racetrack, or medieval castle. Every time, the kitties create a whole new world with amazing discoveries, surprises, and not-so-easy-to-solve dilemmas.

title: Black n White
description: The murder of two politicians of the ruling party creates a lot of chaos in state politics. During the investigation, police get a lead about the biggest drug racket in North East India.

title: Rod 'n' Emu
description: A children's cartoon version of the adventures of real life children's TV entertainer Rod Hull and his maniac pet emu. Most of the stories revolve around the duo's battles with the witch Grotbags, her crocodile and her robot.

title: The N Word
description: A documentary looking at the N word.

title: Eggs 'n' Baker
description: Saturday morning children's cookery series, presented by Cheryl Baker.

title: Matt Okine: Being Black N Chicken N Shit
Cowgirls 'n Angels
description: A group of rodeo trick-riders recruits a young girl to join them.

title: 'n Shrink
description: Dr. Jerry, a psychiatrist, starts an online counseling group for web addicts.

title: Chip 'n Dale: Rescue Rangers
description: Thirty years after their popular television show ended, chipmunks Chip and Dale live very different lives. When a cast member from the original series mysteriously disappears, the pair must reunite to save their friend.

title: L'ennemi public n°0
description: Antoine helps ex-convicts reintegrate into society. But Antoine will encounter a major obstacle: André. After his release from prison, the bank robber André has only one desire: to re-offend. How far will Antoine go to help André?

title: E&N with Ed Neusbit
description: Satirical take on cable news shows, hosted by the unflappable Ed Neusbit.

title: Bldg. N
description: A college student, Shiori, visits an abandoned apartment complex in a provincial city, which is famous for its rumors of hauntings, out of curiosity along with Keita and Maho, who also attend the university. However, there are numerous residents there. As Shiori and her friends begin to investigate, they suddenly experience a violent "bizarre rap phenomenon" and a resident jumps to his death right in front of them.

title: Ed, Edd n Eddy
description: The off-the-wall, day-to-day life of three friends who have exactly the same name.

title: Vice, tinapatan ang talak nina Andrea at Jers sa Miss Q&A
description:
Dedma sa ex na kumakatok at may pasalubong na paulit-ulit na pasakit. But, hello sa grupong nagbabalik sa "It's Showtime" entablado para pagandahin ang araw n'yo. Napaindak ang buong nation sa performance at taas ng energy ng P-Pop group VXON.

Dazzling sa pagrampa sina Miss Q and A Resbakulawan candidates Andrea Jane Peralta, Jers Sabado, at Mama Dhel. Dahil Resbakulawan, diretso nang sumalang ang tatlo sa Wit Lang. Pagkatapos, sina Andrea at Jers ang umabante sa BEKLAMATION.

Na-impress si hurado Nicole Cordoves, pero aminadong nakulangan nang kaunti sa 'chukchak' ng dalawang ladies. Kaya para iwas-bitin, pati si Vice Ganda ay tumalak na rin! Sa huli, itinanghal na Miss Q and A Reyna Talak-Era Resbakulawan daily winner si Andrea.

Hindi na kailangan pang tumama sa lotto para masabing lucky sa araw na 'to! Dahil swerte agad ang lumapit sa mga taga-San Isidro, Cainta Rizal na bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa "It's Showtime."

Walang mapapagod kakatawa sa mga challenges sa game arena. Sa paboritong Act-Song portion sa You Gotta Lyric round, time-out muna sa kilig scenes sina Brent Manalo at Jackie Gonzaga dahil magkapatid muna sila sa isang eksena ng family drama.

Hindi naman horror story ang pagsali ni player Pao. Dahil matapos ma-eliminate, nabunot ang pangalan niya upang maglaro sa jackpot round dahil bigo ang mga naunang players na ma-secure ang spot.

Ramdam ni Vice Ganda ang matinding pangangailangan ni Pao, isang siomai vendor na nag-iipon para sa kanyang operasyon sa mata dahil sa kondisyon na keratoconus. Ramdam din nito ang puso ng manlalaro. Kaya para bang binigyan niya ito ng lakas ng loob na sugalan ang POT question.

Pigil ang hininga ng Madlang People at lahat ng nasa studio, hanggang sa isinigaw ni Pao ang sagot. Bumuhos ang emosyon at saya nang i-anunsyo ni Vice Ganda na tama ang sagot ni Pao at maiuuwi nito ang P350,000 POT money.

title: It's Showtime
description:
Bumilis ang pintig ng puso ng kababaihan sa studio dahil sa pagdating ng mga gwapo. P-Pop group na AJAA, pinakilig ang mga tao, 'yung kilig na may halong kaba kapag si crush ay nasa tabi mo na. They performed their single "Kakabakaba," na perfect background music kapag nakikita ang taong nagpapabilis ng heartbeat mo.

Hindi pwedeng umatras ang mga beki na kinakabahan kapag oras na ng talakan. Panibagong linggo ng Miss Q and A, sinimulan nina Marjorie Lopez Buenaobra, Jov Prado, at Babyloves Monroe Solito.

Astig ang kandidatang si Marjorie na game mag-dance exhibition with buwis-buhay moves. Aray mo, bhie! Doble naman ang pressure na nilabanan ni Babyloves sa entablado dahil sumali na rin ang sa Miss Q and A ang boyfriend niya at umuwing panalo. Kaya biro ni Jhong Hilario, parang 'niraket' ng mag-bebe ang Miss Q and A. 

Sumakses si Marjorie sa unang round at sumalpak sa Wit Lang kung saan nabunot niya ang tanong na, "Bakit tuwalya ang laman ng goto, at hindi bimpo?" Naka-face off niya si Jov na naging witty rin as she 'talak-ed' sa nabunot na question, "Bakit magaan lang ang hibe?" 

Bumuhos ang emosyon sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa mva kuwento ng katatagan at pagmamahal na ibinihagi ng Madlang Solo Parents mula NCR.

Bumilib ang Madlang People sa laki ng pagmamahal ni Danny sa mga anak, pati sa matibay nitong pananampalataya. Mahirap man daw ang buhay pero sisikapon ng biyudong si Danny na itaguyod ang pag-aaral ng mga anak.

Very beautiful naman ang smile ni Eve sa kabila ng madilim na pinagdaanan sa kamay ng dating asawa. Eh, kung ready na siya na muling buksan ang puso, si Ogie Alcasid may irereto.

Ang swerte ay kumapit kay player Nelle, na hindi rin napigilan ang luha nang ikuwento ang pinagdaanan bilang ina. Matapos umuwi mula Taiwan, kung saan sya nagtrabaho at nanganak, bigla na lang tumigil sa pagsusustento ang ama ng kanyang anak.

Naging praktikal si Nelle at tinanggap ang Li-Pot offer. Tama kaya ang kanyang desisyon?

description:
Limang ‘accla’ na maririkit ang nagpasiklaban ng wit sa isa na namang masayang weekly finals ng Miss Q and A sa "It's Showtime."

Bago ang talakan, enjoy muna ang mga Miss Q and A weekly finlists at ang mga hosts na sina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario sa kuwentuhan. Dahil Sabado at bihis na bihis ang mga 'fersons,' hindi maiwasan ang OOTD puksaan. Si Vice, napagtulungan dahil sa suot niyang shorts na basketball uniform daw, at boots na pampulis kalawakan. Si Jhong naman, very Gen Z at trendy sa buhok na kulot. Hirit naman ni Vice sa suot na nude vest ni Vhong, parang action star ang pormahan pero may Barbie arms.

Samantala, na-miss ni Vice Ganda ang pagkikita nila ni candidate Bong Bong, na lumaban noong August 13. Papayag nga ba si Meme na rumesbak si Bong Bong?

Idol talaga sa chukchakan sina Miss Q&A weekly finalists Jurexa Caparino, Nadimunyo Lustre, Miss Pau Ellarina Ortiz, Rocky Cueva, at CK Alcaraz Zarfl.

Si Nadimunyo ang unang naligwak sa kompetisyon, samantalang ang apat ay umabante sa Wit Lang. Mula naman sa apat, ang Top 2 na sina Rocky at CK ang nag-face off sa final round, Beklamation, kung saan pareho nilang hinarap ang tanong na, "Ano ang mas mahirap—tanggapin ang ayaw mo o tanggihan ang gusto mo?"

Mahusay sila sa time management habang pinagsasabay ang sports at academics. Pero sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, maging champion kaya ang mga student athletes?

Si player Angel-El, may pag-demo ng karate moves. Ingat lang baka matamaan ng sumisipa niyang galawan! Sumisipa rin ang good vibes sa aktingan round na You Gotta Lyric. Ito na ba 'yung DaCkie in an LQ scene? Ay, sina Ryan Bang at Teddy Corpuz pala!

Bigo ang mga natirang players na mka-survive hanggang dulo, kaya bumunot ng isang lucky manlalaro. Parang buzzer beater shot, biglang nabuhay ang kapalaran ni Jayvee. Hindi man niya nasagot ang POT question, hanga pa rin si Vice Ganda sa fighting spirit ni Jayvee at sa sipag ng mga kabataang atleta, kaya naisip niyang regaluhan ng extra P1,000 ang bawat players.

description:

Sabi nila, respect your elders, kaya saludo tayo sa mga seniors na sa dami ng karanasan ay matatawag na certified life achievers. This Thursday sa Miss Q and A segment ng "It's Showtime," nagkasukatan ng seniority at timeless wit at beauty.

Ang ating senyoritang sosyal at elegante, rumampa sa Miss Q&A, walang iba kundi si Señora Danica Parong Evidente. Sa isang titig niya baka ikaw ay matulala, walang kupas ang karisma ni Medusa Valentina Galema. At kayo na raw ang humusga kung tao ba o hayop si candidate Exotic Tayop.

Biro ng hosts, tatawagin nating "Miss Q and A" Senior Edition ang segment for today's video dahil may twenty percent discount na ang mga 'lola' n'yo. Pero sa kulitan, full price ang tawanan. May aral din na mapupulot tungkol sa mga pangarap na hindi dapat ibaon na lang sa limot. Dahil age is just a number, pero ang 'slayable' attitude will last forever.

Sa pagtitinda ng laruan, bata ang madalas nilang pinasasaya. Pero sa araw na 'to, sila naman ang nabigyan ng ligaya sa game arena. Toy sellers mula NCR ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick.

Si player Ria, never paglalaruan ang puso ng nobyong si Eric. At never niya itong ipagpapalit kahit kanino, kahit kay Ralph de Leon pa! Biceps at makinis na kutis ni Ralph, hindi umubra!

Dahil walang naka-survive sa mga challenges, bumunot ng lucky player na aabante sa jackpot round, mga bes. Si Liza ang pinabalik sa game arena para sa chance na maiuwi ang malaking kwarta!

title: AJAA may perfect anthem para sa mga KINAKABAHAN kay crush
description:
Bumilis ang pintig ng puso ng kababaihan sa studio dahil sa pagdating ng mga gwapo. P-Pop group na AJAA, pinakilig ang mga tao, 'yung kilig na may halong kaba kapag si crush ay nasa tabi mo na. They performed their single "Kakabakaba," na perfect background music kapag nakikita ang taong nagpapabilis ng heartbeat mo.

Hindi pwedeng umatras ang mga beki na kinakabahan kapag oras na ng talakan. Panibagong linggo ng Miss Q and A, sinimulan nina Marjorie Lopez Buenaobra, Jov Prado, at Babyloves Monroe Solito.

Astig ang kandidatang si Marjorie na game mag-dance exhibition with buwis-buhay moves. Aray mo, bhie! Doble naman ang pressure na nilabanan ni Babyloves sa entablado dahil sumali na rin ang sa Miss Q and A ang boyfriend niya at umuwing panalo. Kaya biro ni Jhong Hilario, parang 'niraket' ng mag-bebe ang Miss Q and A. 

Sumakses si Marjorie sa unang round at sumalpak sa Wit Lang kung saan nabunot niya ang tanong na, "Bakit tuwalya ang laman ng goto, at hindi bimpo?" Naka-face off niya si Jov na naging witty rin as she 'talak-ed' sa nabunot na question, "Bakit magaan lang ang hibe?" 

Bumuhos ang emosyon sa Laro Laro Pick game arena sa mva kuwento ng katatagan at pagmamahal na ibinihagi ng Madlang Solo Parents mula NCR.

Bumilib ang Madlang People sa laki ng pagmamahal ni Danny sa mga anak, pati sa matibay nitong pananampalataya. Mahirap man daw ang buhay pero sisikapon ng biyudong si Danny na itaguyod ang pag-aaral ng mga anak.

Very beautiful naman ang smile ni Eve sa kabila ng madilim na pinagdaanan sa kamay ng dating asawa. Eh, kung ready na siya na muling buksan ang puso, si Ogie Alcasid may irereto.

Ang swerte ay kumapit kay player Nelle, na hindi rin napigilan ang luha nang ikuwento ang pinagdaanan bilang ina. Matapos umuwi mula Taiwan, kung saan sya nagtrabaho at nanganak, bigla na lang tumigil sa pagsusustento ang ama ng kanyang anak.

Naging praktikal si Nelle at tinanggap ang Li-Pot offer. Tama kaya ang kanyang desisyon? 

#ShowtimeNovemberGV
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: Miss Q&A: Mga pamahiin sa pagsali sa pageants
description:
Sa dami ng nangyayari sa paligid, kailangan natin ng good news at good vibes para i-reset ang ating isip. Dito sa "It's Showtime," happiness overload ang mga eksenang mapapanood.

Isang pagbati ang ipinarating ng It's Showtime family sa 21-year-old world tennis champion na si Alex Eala, na gumawa ng kasaysayan sa mundo ng tennis matapos makuha ang kauna-unahang WTA title para sa Pilipinas nang talunin niya si world No. 3 Jessica Pegula ng United States sa 2026 Mubadala DC Open, na ginanap sa Washington D.C.

Mula sa isang alamat sa mundo ng sports, isang alamat sa larangan ng P-Pop din ang bumisita. Sinimulan ng P-Pop favorite Alamat ang episode with a performance of their track, "Sinigang," na inihain ng grupo specially for you!

Bawal ang nega, pero welcome dito si Negi, ang guest co-host of the day, na join sa pakikipagkulitan nina Jhong Hilario at Ogie Alcasid sa Miss Q&A candidates.

May pasok, as in pasok sa banga ang wit at pagrampa nina Miss Q&A Cheska Deyn, Leo Castillo, at Angelbert Castill. At pasok sa banga ang mga paandar nila't special skills. Sina Cheska at Angelbert ang umabante sa Round 2, Wit Lang, kung saan sagot nila'y sure na sure, showing grace under pressure.

Hindi suspended ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Sumugod s rumaragasang god vibes at papremyo ang Madlang Players mula Pamplona, Las Pinas City.

Kapag 'Kim' ang pangalan, maganda talaga ang ngiti n'yan! Dahil sa magaan na awra ni player Kim, isang 21-year-old daddy, nag-enjoy ang hosts na makipagkuwentuhan sa kanya tungkol sa trabaho't pamilya.

Enjoy rin ang Madlang People sa libreng 'sine' sa FUNanghalian. Sa Act-Song portion ng You Gotta Lyric round, may horror at comedy, at may kilig hatid ng tambalang DaCKie!

#ShowtimePakSayaKa
#ItsShowtimeFullEpisode 
#ABSCBNEntertainment

title: The Last Air Race; the Story of the Iconic P-51D Mustang Miss America
description: The world famous P-51Mustang, "Miss America," began her journey in the sport of air racing. From 1969 to 2023 Miss A has traveled to the Reno Air Races "Valley of Speed". Miss A's beautiful Red, White, and Blue paint scheme has made her one of the most recognized P-51's in the world. But all good things must come to an end. Miss America, her pilot and crew, have one final chance to win the coveted Gold Race. This story is about her 45 year journey, and the impact she has made on the fans and aviation community of the world.

title: P@St Forward
description: In 2022, 30-year-old Eliott, an ordinary salesman, writes to his first email address - from when he was ten - to check if it's still available. He's shocked when a reply comes from himself in 2001. As young Eliott listens to his older self's advice and crazy requests in regular emails, he starts to change the future for friends and family, as well as alter the course of his own destiny. Young Eliott tells his parents he's exchanging emails with his future self and gets sent to Dr Sax, a psychologist. Sax sees Eliott's incredible ability to predict the future (everything from 9/11 to new technology) as an endless source of power and money. When Eliott tries to escape his clutches, he finds himself pointing a gun at Sax - both in 2001 and 2022. But which Eliott kills him? Back in 2022, Eliott finally establishes a happy new reality, and everything appears settled. That is until he receives a phone call...from himself in 2042.

title: Sevvel
description: Sudalai (Raj Kiran) is a village chieftain who enjoys great respect among villagers. He leads a happy life with his wife Sevandhi (Seetha). However, due to some turn of events, he is forced to clean the slippers of the villagers by the local police. Unable to tolerate the insult meted out, he and his wife decide to leave the village with their young son Sevvel (Jai Akash). Sudalai manages to join a State Minister as his car driver and stays in her house in Chennai and visits his house once a week. One day, an advocate Parasuram (Kalabhavan Mani) in a fit of rage murders the Minister and manages to escape, leaving the blame on Sudalai. He is arrested and gets life imprisonment. On hearing the news, his wife dies of shock and the child gets orphaned only to be taken care by a noble heart. Years roll by and Sudalai settles down in Chennai and ekes out a livelihood by running an old paper mart. Meanwhile, Sevvel grows up and his search for his father continues. He grows up to a noble hearted youth who joins a law college. He works in Sudalai's paper mart without knowing that he is his father. He passed out in flying colours in his law exams and joins as Parasuram's junior.The rest is all emotional drama which culminates with Jai Akash taking revenge of Parasuram and a reunion with his father.

description:
Kilig at good vibes ang hatid ng bisitang power couple na sina Jessa Zaragoza at Dingdong Avanzado sa kanilang performance, kasabay ng pagdiriwang nila ng kanilang 25th wedding anniversary. Parang ‘nainggit’ si Kim Chiu?

I-add ang tapang, i-multiply ang galing, tapos i-subtract ang kaba para mag-win. Mga future engineers ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Ang usapang crush at rejection, idaan na lang natin 'yan sa karaoke session! Kapag ba galing sa vacay, talagang unlimited ang energy? Ayun, muntik na namang mag-OT sina Meme!

"Woke up like this" ang peg ni Kyle in his kulot-kulutan hairdo. Ano nga ba ang goal niya, and in the future, saan niya balak gamitin ang talento? Kinilala nina Vice Ganda ang Dean's Lister at scholar na 'to! Si Charz naman, eksaherada ang 'sikip' ng "Tala" dance moves with backup dancers! Ang lakas ng 'amats' ng mga estudyante, gigil n'yo tuloy si Meme!

Ika'y mapapangiti sa ganda ni Bianca Umali, na guest co-host nina Vice Ganda at Amy Perez sa Laro Laro Pick, July 25 episode ng “It’s Showtime,” kung saan bumida ang mga taga-Don Bosco, Paranaque.

Sa pamamagitan ng kanyang awitin, ginamit ni TNT champ JM Yosures ang boses para imulat ang mata ng mga Pilipino, na lahat tayo ay may kontribusyon upang labanan ang kahirapan.

description:
Stay safe and stay dry, Madlang People! Kung malakas man ang buhos ng ulan, stay home muna as much as possible. "It's Showtime" and chill muna sabay sayaw ng moves na nakaka-"Oooh Lala!" Kaninong pambato ang panalo sa "Oooh Lala Baby" dance for today's video?

Sa haba man ng kuwentuhan with candidates Divine Geralde, Vavaing Vurdado, at Mentoy Alexa Ang, sa Tumpak Ganern round pa rin ang tuloy.

Struggle is real ang ma ‘accla’ sa tawag sa baby Elephant, at pati sa lugar sa Bulacan kung saan sumasayaw ang mga babaeng humihiling na magka-anak. At ang iconic quote ni Julius Caesar, nabago na pala?!

Kasintapang ng kape ang fighting spirit ng mga baristang sumalang sa game arena kung saan sanib pwersa sina Vice Ganda at Karylle with Tyang Amy Perez.

Parang kape na ayaw mong tigilan, 'amats' naman ni Vice Ganda ang intern ng programa na biglang napasali pa sa aktingan. Samantala, para bang hindi basta aktingan lang ang hugot ni Ryan Bang kay Kim Chiu sa isang eksena. Hopia ba talaga?!

Saktong timpla ng swerte at diskarte ang mayroon si Ver, kaya sa jackpot round, siya ang umabante. Sumugal si Ver sa POT question, na may kinalaman tungkol sa kapeng barako.

title: Emma Tiglao umupo bilang Miss Q and A hurado
description:
I-on ang playlist at maki-sound trip with hip-hop artist J Rose, na ipinarinig ang bago niyang single at ibinahagi ang kuwento sa likod nito.

Makitawa naman sa mga kandidatang laban na laban sa Miss Q and A. Sa kanilang mga talak, atensyon mo'y mahahatak! Palaban sa puksaan sina Andrea Lim ng Pampanga, Rhian Orain ng Valenzuela, at Pau Chiu ng Manila.

Ang pangalan ni Candidate No. 3, inspired by Chinita Princess Kim Chiu, na 'peg' niya at idolo. Pero sa paningin ni Vice Ganda, hindi naman si Kim ang kanyang nakikita. Para bang deja vu, namalikmata si Meme at nakita si Tado! Biro niya, "Si Candidate #3 ay nakaaway ko no'ng Season 1." Baka ito na nga ang 'closure' na inaabangan.

Hirit ni Meme, "Mga bakla, aral-aral din." Pero sa hinaba-haba man ng kulitan, may dalwang kandidata na umabante sa second round, at ito ay sina Andrea at Pau. Ang tanong kay Andrea, "Papayag ka ba na marami kang pera pero na kay Vice Ganda?" At si Pau naman, natanong kung papayag siyang maging doktor kahit madali siyang mahawa ng mga sakit.

Pagkatapos ng WIT Lang, si Andrea ang pinusuan nina hurado Karylle, Brent Manalo, at Miss Grand International 2025 Emma Tiglao, at itinanghal na Reyna TalakEra of the day.

Sa araw na 'to, mga taga-Mahabang Parang, Angono Rizal ang bumida sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Kapag nagsama-sama naman ang Showtime hosts sa 'You Gotta Lyric' round, ibig sabihin, masaya ang aktingan. Si Lassy, pinagtulungan na buhatin. Teka, saan n'yo siya dalahen?

Best friends ni Christian ang mga alagang baboy dahil sila ang nagdadala sa kanya ng swerte at kabuhayan. Kaya 'pag nakuha niya ang P100,000 sa paglalaro sa jackpot round, ang mga alagang baboy, sure na madadagdagan.

title: Nabigo sa Ral nagbabalik sa Miss Q&A
description:
Sagot na ni JM Dela Cerna ang pangmalakasang harana. Parang hugis 'otso,' to infinity and beyond ang husay ni JM sa entablado. Pati 'What's up, Madlang People' ibinirit nang todo.

Great ang performance ng tatlong beki na nagtalakan sa Miss Q and A, na sina Ral Imperial ng Batangas, Carla Flores Argonza ng Pangasinan, at Martie Anne Panlilio ng Tarlac.

Hindi 'puchu-puchu' ang tatlong ito, na pare-parehong may napatunayan na sa kanilang pag-aaral. Si Ral ay may dalawang Latin honors, si Carla naman ay may double degree, at si Martie ay scholar.

Na-earn nina Ral at Carla ang respeto ng mga hurado sa talak nilang galing sa puso at pinag-isipan during the Wit Lang round. Nabunot ni Ral ang tanong na, "Sa iyong palagay, saan mas hirap si Rapunzel, mag-blower o mag-shampoo?" Kalmado rin ang pagsagot ni Carla sa tanong na, "Kung huling hininga mo na, anong mas gusto mo, pa-inhale o pa-exhale?"

Markado ang sagot ni Carla kina hurados Ralph de Leon, Nicole Cordoves, at Esnyr na nagbihis bilang Ms. Castro, isa sa mga karakter sa kanyang online series.

Sa Laro Laro Pick, lahat ay swerte, walang malas. Kaya positive vibes lang ang dala ng mga taga-Navotas. Ang laro, nauwi sa concert nang maka-face off ni player Diane si Baby Doll Johaira sa sayawan at kantahan.

Naubos ang players sa It's Giving round kaya bumunot ng dalawang sasabak sa You Gotta Lyric, at ito ay sina Roland at Dindin. Lahat ay lucky pero si Dindin ang may pinakabonggang swerte.

Si Dindin, isang mananahi na solo parent, maingat na pumili. Kung ang kasamang anak ay forda experience ang gusto, si Nanay Dindin, mas gustong maging sigurado at tinanggap ang P40,000 Li-Pot offer.

title: Miss Q&A: Ano ang English ng tanikala?
description:
Maligayawang kaarawan, Chief of OPM Ogie Alcasid. Bukod sa "It's Showtime" family, present to celebrate ang nag-iisang reyna sa puso niya, his forever favorite ka-duet, his misis Regine Velasquez. From the heart ang mensahe ni Asia's Songbird sa chief ng kanilang tahanan.

Imbitado rin sa episode ang isa pang hitmaker, Moira dela Torre, na ginulat ang malang people sa mataas niyang energy.

Hit at bentang-benta rin ang witty talak ng tatlong kandidata sa Miss Q and A. Break muna sa pagbubbunot ng ngipin ang dentistang si Dra. Ruth Qanal, at sa chukchakan muna siya humugot ng banat. Ima-mine mo rin ang good vibe na dala ni Dyeyzel Romero, ang live seller talakera. At agaw-eksena ang intro ni Nunoy, na para bang dinala tayo sa liga ng basketball.

Triple treat din ang attendance nina Anne Curtis, Vice Ganda, at Vhong Navarro, na hindi matapos-tapos ang kulitan at bardagulan. Anne is back, and so is her 'bulol' hosting, kaya si Meme Vice ay 'nabuwisit' sa kanyang sabaw moments.

Pati ang hosts nag-enjoy sa mga tanong sa Tumpak Ganern. Ano nga ba sa Ingles ang tanikala? At ang isang bugtong, nasagot ni Anne, but as usual, in a sosyal way nga lang!

Nag-babu nang maaga si doktora, matapos maligwak sa Tumpak Ganern round. Kaya sina Dyeyzel at Nunoy ang umabante sa Wit Lang.

From palengke, napasugod sa game arena ang mga masisipag na tindero't tindera. Pasok, mga suki, swerte ay hitik sa Laro Laro Pick.

Usapang isda muna tayo kasama si nanay Dada, na nag-sample kung paano mag-alok sa mga parokyano at pumaldo nang todo. Ang isa pang sikreto, dapat kilay on fleek upang ang customers ay maakit.

Gulay na madaling itanim at anihin naman ang category sa It's Giving kung saan dalawa lang ang natira. It's Dada versus Mila. Pagdatating sa hulaan ng title ng kanta, parehong olats ang dalawa. Kaya bumunot ng iba, at ang swerte ay kay Mie napunta.

P450,000 ang pwede niyang mapanalunan. Syemmpre, gusto ni Mie 'yan! Pero mas pinili niyang maging praktikal at tanggapin ang Li-Pat offer na P50,000. 'Yun nga lang, alam pala ni Mie ang sagot sa katanungan.

title: Kandidata, may matinding pinagdadaanan sa Miss Q&A
description:
Bumisita ngayong maulan na Wednesday ang bandang Hilera, na ibinandera ang OPM punk rock genre sa kanta nilang "Diretso." Ipinakilala rin ng banda ang bago nilang miyembro.

Kumpleto muli ang energetic trio nina Vhong Navarro, Vice Ganda, at Jhong Hilario, na sinimulan ng Miss Q and A sa puksaan ng OOTD... at odor?!

Tuloy-tuloy naman ang puksaan sa rampahan as the Miss Q and A candidates walked the runway in their pakak-tail dresses. Nagpakilala sina Stacey Doroteo, Jillian Indefonso, at Queen Mortel. At bago ang paunahan sa pagsagot ng trivia questions sa Tumapk Ganern round, kinilatis muna ang ladies sa kanilang talent at energy.

Kung si Stacey ay pinagkakakitaan ang husay sa pagsasalita bilang host, hirit ni Meme, 'yung iba pinagkakakitaan ang bibig sa maling paraan katulad ng pagkakalat ng chismis at fake news. No, no 'yan! Heto ang hindi fake news, si Queen Mortel, may pinagdadaanan. Kaya naman ang hosts, sumuko na lang matapos mag-fail na ilabas ang highest energy ni Queen.

Epic fail in the funniest way naman ang sagot ng mga 'accla' sa mga tanong sa unang round, katulad ng tanong na may kinalaman sa matamis na syrup sa taho, Filipino term para sa petal, at pangalan ni Mars Ravelo.

Sa hinaba-haba man ng hulaan, sa Wit Lang pa rin ang tuloy nina Stacey at Queen Mortel. Ang nabunot na tanong ni Stacey, "Anong mas mahirap i-maintain, relasyon o bank bank balance?" Tumapat naman kay Queen Mortel ang tanong na, "Alin ang mas nakakagising ng group chat, 'yung bagong tsismis o 'yung may nag-leave sa group?"

Kung suspended ang klase, ’wag munang malungkot. Ang mga college students from Pasay, sa "It's Showtime" muna pumasok. At ang activity nila, mag-enjoy sa Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Nakipagkuwentuhan sina Vice Ganda, Karylle, at Ogie Alcasid sa mga bisitang etsudyante. As they get to know the students, mas napansin ni Vice na para bang nawawala na ang sense of curiosity ng mga kabataan, kaya pinaalalahanan niya ang mga estudyante na maging curious sa paligid at palawakin ang kaalaman.

Samantala, kung bibigyan ni teacher ng grade ang mga eksena sa You Gotta Lyric, siguradong lahat ay makakamartsa sa entablado dahil sa aktingan na pasado. Si Jackie Gonzaga, biglang

nag-transform in the middle of her scene with Cianne Dominguez, kaya hirit ni Meme Vice, "I love the plot twist!"

Heto ang plot twist in life na hinihintay ni Zie, ang Business Administration student na umabante sa jackpot round. Sinugalan ni Zie ang P250,000 POT question ngunit bigo itong maibigay ang tamang sagot sa tanong na, "Anong instrumento ang ginagamit sa pagsukat ng bilis ng hangin?"

Hindi pa rin siya uuwing luhaan dahil sa P5,000 ayuda mula kay Vice Ganda.

title: OGs plus Gen Zs! Vice, Anne, Darren, Brent nagkulitan sa Miss Q&A
description:
Ang mga divas ng Tawag Ng Tanghalan, pagdating sa kantahan, siguradong palaban at walang inuurungan. Intense na birit ang bitbit nina Carmelle Ccollado, Lyka Estrella, Arvery Lagoring, at Marielle Montellano na sanib-pwersa sa pagkanta ng "Gusto Ko Nang Bumitaw."

In real life, may gusto rin ba silang bitawan? Heto pa ang hindi mo gugustuhing palampasin. Si Jillian Ward, kumasa sa 'Meme' dance challenge. Si Ogie Alcasid, hindi mapigilang mag-reminisce. Parang kailan lang, si Jillian ay little girl na makulit pero ngayon isa nang binibining marikit.

Sina Anne Curtis, Vice Ganda, Brent Manalo, at Darren Espanto nag-collab sa pag-host ng Miss Q and A segment para sa September 4 episode. Si Brent, hindi mapakali dahil katabi niya ang crush na "Dyosa." Hanggang sa nauwi ang kulitan sapersonalan?!

Tatlong kandidata ang rumampa para subukan ang kanilang wit sa Miss Q and A. Meet Jessy Fami, Maria Princess Joy Rosario, at Hera Sanchez Santivañez. Sina Hera at Maria ang umabante sa Wit Lang round, kung saan hinarap nila ang questions na may kasamang playtime geography lessons? Kay Hera, “Kung kalbo ka, titira ka pa ba sa Laguna?” habang kay Maria naman tumapat ang tanong na, “Pwede bang maglakad ang mga bakla sa Baclaran?”

Kapag swerte ang kumatok, dapat agad pagbuksan. Dahil baka ito na ang araw na papabor sa'yo ang kapalaran. Lahat ng hamon ay kakayanin because they can! Sa Laro Laro Pick game arena, bumida ang mga taga-Bocaue, Bulacan.

Ang dating line cook na si Kurt ang naka-survive sa lahat ng challenges at umabante sa jackpot round kung saan matapang niyang sinugalan ang P200,000 POT question. Umabot sa P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer pero sayang nga naman ang pagkakataon.

title: Miss Q&A Lucky, may love advice sa co-candidate na NBSB
description:
Pagkatapos ng kanyang historic win sa 'Tawag Ng Tanghalan' Ika-10 Taon, noong nakaraang linggo, nagbabalik si Yannie Paul Basical sa entablado upang muling iparinig ang tinig na nangibabaw sa TNT stage.

Ang mga beki sa "Miss Q and A," parang naka-unli cups of coffee sa taas ng energy. Sa rampahan pa lang ay to the maximum level na ang bardagulan ng mga contestants—Queen Angie ng Rizal, Jerica Perater ng Leyte, at Lucky Rosales Collins ng Manila.

No'ng isang araw, may napagdudahan ang kabaklaan. At parang déjà vu, mayro'ng muntik nang 'imbestigahan' for today's video. Ang "It's Showtime" hosts, parang duda kung 19 years old ba talaga si Contestant #2!

Promise, bagets pa siya, kaya nga hindi pa nagkaka-jowa! At para ipa-feel naman kay Jerica ang tamis ng pumapag-ibig, siya'y pinakilig ni Ryan Bang, ang ating 'oppa,' sa isang ekena na nagtapos sa slow-mo moment ala K-Drama.

At parang slow-mo rin ang performance ng mga kandidata sa TumPak Ganern round. Sina Lucky at Queen Angie naman ang nagtalakan sa ‘Wit Lang’ kung saan pumili sila ng magkaibang katanungan.

Isandaang libo ang pwedeng mapunta sa maswerteng taga-Cupang, Mutinlupa na makakarating sa dulo ng Laro Laro Pick game arena.

Pagdating sa aktingan, all-star cast ang eksenang digmaan. Walang nakapaghanda sa 'props' na dala ni Vice Ganda. Ang mga hosts, hindi na nakaiwas! Si Meme may mga dalang 'pasabog' at panlaban, kaya ang digmaan ay nauwi sa katatawanan!

Sa dami ng nangyari, si player Ali ang kinapitan ng swerte. Ang Li-Pot offer, itinodo na sa P30K! Alin ang pipiliin ni Ali?
